feature_descriptions.sleep_hours: Average daily sleep duration in hours (valid range 0-24)
feature_descriptions.work_study_hours: Average daily study/work duration in hours (valid range 0-24)
feature_descriptions.physical_activity_minutes: Daily physical activity in minutes (valid range 0-1440)
feature_descriptions.mood_rating: Recent mood check-in average on 1-5 scale
feature_descriptions.journal_sentiment: Recent journal sentiment polarity score (-1.0 to +1.0)
feature_descriptions.negative_emotion_frequency: Frequency ratio of negative emotions (sadness, fear, anger, disgust) in recent journals (0.0 to 1.0)
